notes:
**A finding no longer shows a number that contradicts its own headline.**

Docket told a hospital "Only 2 recognised profiles in sameAs" and put the number
**16** on the badge beside it. Sixteen was the count of profile types the site
had *not* linked, out of Docket's list of eighteen — the opposite of what the
headline counted, and an implication that every organisation ought to hold all
eighteen. Nobody needs a Better Business Bureau listing, a GitHub organisation
and an App Store page.

It also cost score. The deduction for a finding grows with its count, so
counting the ones you are missing made this penalty **40% larger** than it
should have been — on the milder of the two sameAs findings, while the more
serious one, for having no profile links at all, carried no inflation.

The headline already tells you how many profiles it found, so the badge is gone
and the score is no longer touched by a number nobody could read.
